summary: Interact Club of Hiranandani Foundation School has made a wonderful contribution towards “Padho Bharat 2026” by collecting an impressive 1,480 books from the students of the school.
description:
Interact Club of Hiranandani Foundation School has made a wonderful contribution towards “Padho Bharat 2026” by collecting an impressive 1,480 books from the students of the school.

These books will help support the nationwide initiative of India Humanity Foundation, aimed at collecting books and creating thousands of libraries across the country.
